---
applyTo: "frontend/credit-bureau-web/src/**/*.{ts,tsx}"
---

# Frontend guidance

- Use TypeScript; author React components in `.tsx` files and shared data/types in `.ts` files.
- Keep customer, bank, broker, application, report, and agent features in their corresponding feature folders.
- Preserve accessible labels, keyboard interaction, responsive behavior, and clear loading/error states.
- Mark seed content as fictional and never present a demo risk indicator as an actual credit decision.
